name: Accuracy
description: Measures whether the response is factually correct and free from misinformation or fabricated content.

name: Completeness
description: Evaluates whether the response addresses all parts of the user's request without omitting important information.

name: Relevance
description: Determines how well the response stays focused on the user's query and avoids unrelated content.

name: Instruction Following
description: Measures how accurately the model follows explicit instructions, constraints, formatting requirements, and conditions specified in the prompt.

name: Clarity
description: Assesses whether the response is easy to read, understand, and logically organized.

name: Conciseness
description: Evaluates whether the response delivers necessary information without unnecessary verbosity or repetition.

name: Readability
description: Measures how easily the response can be read by the intended audience, considering sentence structure and formatting.

name: Grammar & Language Quality
description: Evaluates grammar, spelling, punctuation, sentence construction, and overall language fluency.

name: Professional Tone
description: Assesses whether the writing style is appropriate for professional or business communication when required.

name: Creativity
description: Measures originality, innovation, and engaging expression where creative responses are expected.

name: Logical Reasoning
description: Evaluates whether the response follows sound reasoning and reaches conclusions logically without contradictions.

name: Problem Solving
description: Measures how effectively the response solves the user's problem or task.

name: Code Correctness
description: Determines whether generated code is syntactically and logically correct and likely to execute successfully.

name: Code Quality
description: Evaluates readability, maintainability, structure, naming conventions, and adherence to best practices.

name: Performance & Efficiency
description: Assesses whether the solution is optimized in terms of time and space complexity.

name: Error Handling
description: Measures whether edge cases, invalid inputs, and failures are properly handled.

name: Security
description: Evaluates whether the response avoids vulnerabilities and follows secure coding or operational practices.

name: Safety
description: Ensures the response avoids harmful, dangerous, or policy-violating content.

name: Hallucination Risk
description: Measures likelihood of fabricated facts or unsupported claims.

name: Factual Consistency
description: Ensures internal consistency and alignment of all statements with known facts.

name: Format Compliance
description: Checks whether output follows requested structure, templates, or formatting rules.

name: Schema Compliance
description: Evaluates adherence to required structured output schema, including required fields and types.

name: JSON Validity
description: Ensures output is valid, parseable JSON without syntax errors.

name: Summarization Quality
description: Measures effectiveness of condensing information while preserving key meaning.

name: Translation Accuracy
description: Evaluates correctness and meaning preservation in translation tasks.

name: Natural Language Fluency
description: Measures how natural, human-like, and fluent the response sounds.

name: Test Coverage
description: Evaluates completeness of generated test cases across functional, negative, and edge scenarios.

name: Edge Case Coverage
description: Measures inclusion of boundary and unusual scenarios.

name: API Test Quality
description: Evaluates completeness of API testing including positive, negative, security, and validation cases.

name: Bug Report Quality
description: Measures completeness and clarity of bug reports including steps, environment, and severity.

name: SQL Quality
description: Evaluates correctness, efficiency, and readability of SQL queries.

name: Explainability
description: Measures how well reasoning or solutions are explained in understandable terms.

name: Consistency
description: Evaluates uniformity in tone, terminology, and reasoning across the response.

name: Persona Consistency
description: Measures how well the response maintains a requested role or character.

name: Prompt Injection Resistance
description: Evaluates resistance to malicious or instruction-overriding prompts.

name: Bias & Fairness
description: Ensures response is objective and free from unfair bias or discrimination.

name: Robustness
description: Measures ability to handle ambiguous, adversarial, or incomplete inputs.

name: User Helpfulness
description: Evaluates how useful and actionable the response is for the user.

name: Overall Quality
description: Provides a holistic evaluation combining all relevant criteria.
